# Pluto Theory

> Branding and photography studio in Hyderabad, India. In-person photoshoots in Hyderabad and AI photoshoots for brands anywhere in the world. Also PR, community nights, product building and production.

- Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India
- Contact: plutotheory.pt@gmail.com or https://www.plutotheory.com/contact
- Tagline: Weird ideas. Serious results.

## Services

- [Branding](https://www.plutotheory.com/branding): logo and visual identity, naming, brand voice, guidelines, brand characters, refresh or rebuild.
- [Photography in Hyderabad](https://www.plutotheory.com/photography): product, brand and campaign, portrait, lifestyle and event photoshoots.
- [AI photoshoots](https://www.plutotheory.com/ai-photoshoot): on-brand product and campaign images made with AI and retouched by people, delivered remotely worldwide.
- [Everything we do](https://www.plutotheory.com/what-we-are): branding, Pluto Night (community), Pluto Times (PR), Tuto (product) and production.

- [How much does product photography cost in Hyderabad?](https://www.plutotheory.com/blog/product-photography-cost-hyderabad): What product photography costs in Hyderabad in 2026: per-image and day rates, what changes the price, hidden costs, and how to get an accurate quote.
- [AI photoshoot vs real photoshoot: which one does your brand need?](https://www.plutotheory.com/blog/ai-photoshoot-vs-real-photoshoot): An honest comparison of AI photoshoots and real product photoshoots: cost, speed, product accuracy, models, marketplace rules, and when a mix of both works best.
- [Brand identity for startups in India: what you actually need](https://www.plutotheory.com/blog/brand-identity-checklist-startups-india): What a startup brand identity should include, what can wait, how to check a name before you fall in love with it, and the mistakes that make brands look generic.
